        def find_obj(seg, color, min_pixels=5):
            for n in seg:

        m = re.search(r'MOUSE\(row=(\d+),\s*col=(\d+)\)', action_str)
        click_row, click_col = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        
        # Check what color was at the click position in the before frame

        clicked_char = before_ascii[click_row][click_col]
